label: Start of copy phase (<DEL> step and first copy step) in long sequences
explanation: Fires almost only on the first two output steps: the <DEL> step (recall_idx 0, 63% of activation mass, active on 35% of them) and the first copy step (recall_idx 1, 33% of mass). Some weak firing at recall_idx 2, essentially none in the original phase or later in the copy phase. Firing rate and magnitude grow with sequence length (rate at <DEL> rises with L; L=9 holds 40% of mass vs about 2% for L<=4), so many outputs remain (to_go 6-8). The strongest activations are at <DEL> in L=9 sequences, often followed by a smaller one on the next step. Output token identity changes the rate somewhat (out_tok c/0/f higher, about 20%, while others are near 10%), but token-set conditions did not raise F1. Even within the predicate only about half the steps are active (precision ~0.47), so what decides firing at these steps is not fully captured. Dev: P 0.47, R 0.73, F1 0.57, mass recall 0.81.
